items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I guess the first band that really made me decide that I wanted to play the piano all my life was when I heard Duke Ellington's band.

ctx.x: hear what the piano player was doing. But somehow, I couldn't hear the piano player, because I didn't know how to listen to him. He was playing the chords in the band, but the horns and everything were... My ears weren't that sensitive to actually center the piano player out. But I would watch him anyway. There were guys that had all sorts of ways of sitting sideways at the piano, and all sorts... Which was very interesting to me, you know.

I guess the first band that really made me decide that I wanted to play the piano all my life was when I heard Duke Ellington's band. And in Duke's band I could hear the piano, because Duke played the piano... No matter what was happening, he played with a very dominating force, and you could hear him... He had a little way that he played his accompaniment that was very unique. Besides the way he...
